apps.subtitle: Beta channel for iOS Next
apps.localizedDescription: Private beta channel for iOS Next. Uses the same bundle identifier as Stable and replaces the installed Stable app when activated.

versions.localizedDescription: iOS Next 1.0.10 Beta (Build 14) — automatische Home-Assistant-Identität für Chat-Credentials, serverseitige Owner/Member-Trennung, Device-Binding und Legacy-Fallback; plus Motion V2, Control Center V2, Jarvis, Suche und Reconnect-Verbesserungen.
